thread:
Ada: flagging a performance variance after the launch posts. overall clicks up ~30% but demo starts down notably. sharing quick dashboard: https://dash.redwood/launch-summary
Theo: saw similar. paid-social CTR up, demo conversion down. could be copy or routing.
Maya: note we rolled a landing headline change at 2024-11-19T14:00Z (variant C). also GA attribution window shortened on 11/18. both could affect counts.
-dash-bot: event: landing.update applied by Maya at 2024-11-19T14:00Z, field: hero_variant=C.
Ada: can we get a compact slice: clicks, demo-starts, conv by channel + hero_variant for last 10 days? short SQL helpful.
Theo: shared SQL in thread (sanitized) and ran it. result (summary): hero A (orig): 2,800 clicks -> 210 demos (7.5%); hero C (short): 3,400 clicks -> 98 demos (2.9%).
Maya: similar pattern to previous tests: short hero drives more top-of-funnel but lower demo intent.
Ada: action items: 1) run 7-day paid holdout favoring hero A, 2) add hero_variant to KPI dashboard as a dimension, 3) include attribution model change as context in the weekly KPI email.
Theo: I'll add the dashboard tile and a 14-day rolling conv sparkline, flagging >20% week-over-week deltas.
Maya: I'll revert paid allocation to 80/20 A/C and notify campaign owners.
SalesOps: noted  we'll monitor demo quality.
Ada: thanks team. will capture a short benchmark note for the launch doc: "Variant C increased reach but reduced demo intent; recommend holdout and downstream qualification check before wider rollout." end.
